trees.title: Coconut trees
trees.empty: No trees registered yet. Register your numbered trees to start recording harvests.

bulk.title: Register trees
bulk.intro: Create a numbered range in one go, matching the tags on your trees. Codes that already exist are skipped, never duplicated.
bulk.invalid: Check the range: up to 500 trees at a time.
bulk.noPermission: Your profile doesn't allow registering trees. Ask the farm owner.

tree.notFound: This tree could not be found.
tree.codeHelp: Matches the physical tag. It can't be changed later.
tree.label: Display label (optional)
tree.noHistory: No harvests recorded yet. This is different from a recorded harvest of zero.
tree.duplicate: That tree code is already used on this farm (including archived trees).

errors.conflict: Someone else changed this tree. Close the form and try again.

prediction.title: Next plucking
prediction.notEnoughBody: An estimate appears after at least two recorded pluckings of this tree.

prediction.explain_other: Estimated from {{count}} recorded intervals. Median interval: {{median}} days. Last plucked: {{last}}.

planning.intro: Trees grouped by when they are likely due. Select the ones for the next visit and start a round.
